# bot-answer.js

The `<bot-answer>` web component from [bot-api](https://github.com/dcambur/bot-api),
`src/bot_api/web/bot-answer.js`, copied verbatim. It renders bot-api's component
contract (v1) — the typed tree Claude fills for a sentence explanation — and is
themed only through `--ba-*` CSS variables, which overlay.css maps to the popup's
palette.

Same author, same licence as this project. To update: copy the file again and
note the commit here.
